prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic photography style, 9:16 vertical. An adult Asian woman with black wavy hair sits in front of a bay window in a high-rise building, wearing a very loose white shirt. From a subjective POV, she raises her right hand to gently block the lens with a faint smile and says, "Oh... stop taking pictures of me." She lowers her hand and leans forward until her face occupies most of the frame, looks into the lens, and says in a calm friendly tone, "It's finally the weekend, want to go out for a walk?" Keep natural light, delicate realistic detail, film-grain texture, subtle sleeve rustling, softened city noise outside, and quiet indoor air.
